verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same lazy result. Each keeps the headline stacked on three lines inside a small purple box in the middle of a 728x90 leaderboard, so the original was shrunk rather than rearranged into a single left-to-right line. That leaves the headline only about 15px tall, takes up roughly 20% of the banner's width, and wastes the rest on a cropped, blurry photo strip. A's box has slightly more padding; B's text is a touch larger, but its box nearly touches the top and bottom edges. The differences are too small to matter.
